name: Project 1 front-camera visibility review v1
location_reference: CARLA actor origin in ROS base_link; 3 m is a coarse acceptance tolerance, not an exact box-center claim.
review_coverage: Only the 20 explicitly reviewed keyframes. No labels are inferred for intervening frames.
review_method: Codex visual inspection of original/enlarged RGB images, CARLA actor candidate identity, then geometric LiDAR-support overlay inspection. Not yet signed off by the instructor.

frames.reviewer: Codex visual inspection; instructor may revise
frames.review_note: Camera image visually inspected at original size and enlarged where needed. Eligibility is limited to visibly identifiable recorded cars within 60 m, with uncut image bounds and LiDAR support. No interpolation to unreviewed frames.

objects.review_note: Car is mostly obscured by a foreground palm/tree and roadside structure.
Clearly visible parked car ahead-right.
objects.support_rule: Inside reviewed image rectangle, within actor-origin planar radius hypot(half_extent.x,half_extent.y)+0.5 m, height 0.15 m to 2*half_extent.z+0.3 m above actor origin; positive optical depth. These are geometric support candidates, not semantic point labels.
